body:
## Phase 0 review — Scaffolding

**Status:** all executable tasks merged. Awaiting owner sign-off. Label `signed-off` on epic #1 when done.

### What shipped (PRs)
- #135 root workspace: pnpm 11, Turborepo, Biome, base tsconfig
- #136 `@tone/shared` Zod contracts (Profile, API error envelope), 8 tests
- #137 `@tone/db` Supabase project `tone_tonic` (ports 55321–55324), `profiles` table with RLS forced + auth trigger, seed users, pgTAP
- #138 `@tone/api` NestJS 12: Zod env, `/health` (db ping), `AuthGuard` + `/me`, unit + e2e, Dockerfile
- #139 `@tone/web` Vite 8 + React 19, TanStack Router/Query, Tailwind 4, shadcn Button, health page
- #140 CI: `lint-typecheck-test` + `db` (migrations from scratch, pgTAP, generated-types drift)
- #141 docs alignment; fresh clone → running app in 89 s
- #147 final-review fixes (per-app `.env.example`, CI build, `db lint --fail-on warning`, turbo globals, grant rule)

### How to test (≈10 min)
```bash
git clone git@github.com:matthewtsmith/tone_tonic.git && cd tone_tonic
pnpm install
pnpm db:start          # first run pulls images; project id tone_tonic, ports 5532x
pnpm db:reset
cp apps/api/.env.example apps/api/.env.local
cp apps/web/.env.example apps/web/.env.local
(cd packages/db && supabase status)   # paste anon key into apps/web/.env.local, service_role into apps/api/.env.local
pnpm dev
```
1. Open http://localhost:5173 → expect **API ok** and **DB ok** pills, version line, Refresh button.
2. `curl -s localhost:3000/me` → 401 JSON `{"error":{"code":"unauthorized",...}}`.
3. Get a token and call `/me`:
```bash
ANON=<anon key>
TOKEN=$(curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:55321/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password" -H "apikey: $ANON" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"email\":\"teacher@local.test\",\"password\":\"password123\"}" | python3 -c "import json,sys;print(json.load(sys.stdin)[\"access_token\"])")
curl -s localhost:3000/me -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"   # → {"userId":"11111111-...","email":"teacher@local.test"}
```
4. `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` → all green (test needs the stack running).
5. Studio: http://127.0.0.1:55323 → Table editor → `profiles` shows Terry Teacher and Sam Student.

Seeded logins: `teacher@local.test` / `student@local.test`, password `password123`.

### Known gaps / decisions for you
- #9 branch protection needs GitHub Pro or a public repo. Recommendation: leave until the foreman exists.
- #146 polish batch (Docker `USER node`, strictPort, engines floor, etc.) is Ready.
- Follow-ups filed into Phase 1: #143 global exception filter, #144 Zod↔DB type assertion, #145 pgTAP behaviour tests.
- Stack versions landed newer than the spec text: TypeScript 7 (api pins 6), NestJS 12, Vite 8, Vitest 5, Zod 4.

### Next
Phase 0.5 (foreman, epic #124) needs its plan approved (writing-plans + `plan-approved` label) before agents build it.

- [ ] CI: `permissions: contents: read`, `timeout-minutes` on both jobs; root script `test:ci` = `turbo run test --filter=!@tone/db` and CI calls it

Phase 0.5 plan drafted: [`docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-03-phase-0.5-foreman.md`](https://github.com/matthewtsmith/tone_tonic/blob/main/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-03-phase-0.5-foreman.md) (commit ae0ce74).

**Open questions (§12) resolved with verified CLI behavior (claude 2.1.259):**
1. Permissions: `--permission-mode dontAsk --permission-prompts none --setting-sources user,project`; allowlist in `.claude/settings.json`. `acceptEdits` rejected (auto-approves `touch`-style commands). Project allow rules only apply in a trusted dir → foreman marks each worktree trusted in `~/.claude.json`.
2. Slack connector: confirmed available in `-p` sessions on this Mac (`mcp__claude_ai_Slack__slack_send_message` etc.).
3. Playwright MCP: `@playwright/mcp@0.0.80` pinned in `.mcp.json`, loaded headlessly via `enableAllProjectMcpServers`; verified tools appear.

**Task map:** 12 tasks. #125–#134 map 1:1 to plan tasks 1–8, 10, 11. Two new issues to be created at execution: dev ports web 8082 / api 3005 (+ CLAUDE.md "Ports" section) and `loop.ts` wiring. "Depends on" lines of #125–#134 get rewritten in Task 0.

**Spec deviations recorded in the plan** (spec updated in the same PRs): claim ownership by ledger comments not assignees; validator screenshots to `~/.tone_tonic/artifacts/<pr>/` (no GitHub attachment API); reviewer/validator labels on the PR; validator failures follow the 2-round rule; planner issues file `<plan>.issues.json`.

**Also found:** branch protection returns 403 on this private repo (free plan); guards are the deny rules + roles never merging. Noted in Task 11.

Waiting for "approved" + `plan-approved` label before executing.
